_note: Example records only. Fill the rest following the Symptom Data Guide. 'risks' feed the heap ranking; the tree root asks 'topCause', which the engine answers with the top risk from the heap.

symptoms.label: Chest pain, fainting or shortness of breath

question.text: Most likely cause for this mission month

leaf.title: Your body is adapting
leaf.cause: NASA notes dizziness and coordination problems while the body adjusts to a change in gravity.
leaf.action: Rest, move slowly and re-check next month.

leaf.title: Sleep loss may be involved
leaf.cause: NASA lists chronic sleep loss and irregular body clocks as a spaceflight risk.
leaf.action: Protect your sleep schedule tonight and log how you slept.

question.text: Is your vision different (blurry, hard to focus)?
Did it start suddenly or little by little?

leaf.title: Sudden vision change
leaf.cause: Sudden vision changes need an immediate medical evaluation. NASA tracks eye and brain changes in space.
leaf.action: Stop precise tasks, tell the crew and contact the flight surgeons now.

leaf.title: Possible eye and brain change (SANS)
leaf.cause: NASA reports that the structure of the eyes and brain can change with spaceflight.
leaf.action: Tell the crew and include it in your next report to Earth.

leaf.title: Keep watching
leaf.cause: Headache without vision changes; NASA monitors eye and brain changes on long missions.
leaf.action: Repeat your check-in and tell the crew if it continues.

symptoms.label: Pain in an arm, forearm or leg

leaf.title: Possible fracture
leaf.cause: NASA explains that without gravity bones break down and become more brittle, so breaks are more likely.
leaf.action: Stop using the limb, tell the crew and send a report to the flight surgeons.

leaf.title: Linked to your exercise session
leaf.cause: All astronauts exercise to counteract losses in bone, muscle and heart performance, says NASA.
leaf.action: Rest the area, log it, and keep your next session lighter.

leaf.title: Possible muscle or bone change
leaf.cause: NASA reports bone and muscle loss during spaceflight.
leaf.action: Tell the crew and do today's exercise session carefully.
